propositions: Inbound (Jira → rebar) link ADD operations that fail due to deterministic structural verdicts (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) are re-attempted identically every reconciler pass because no durable failure memory exists.

The applier applies warn-and-continue exception handling without recording failed links, so the differ re-emits the same impossible ADDs every pass, producing ~200 doomed rebar.link writes/hour and a permanent WARNING error floor.

A classify function must distinguish permanent structural failures (closed_source, redundant_ancestry, cycle) from transient exceptions, recording only the permanent shapes to avoid suppressing legitimate future attempts.

The deciding digest for an impossible link record must cover the endpoint statuses, parent chains, and dependency sets that the three validators inspect, plus the global structural projection for cycle verdicts to catch intermediate ticket changes that break cycles.

impossible_links.json must be committed to the tickets branch by reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot so that records survive between CI passes, otherwise the skip would never take effect in production.
